newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Ports update - Australia - Lloyds Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Ports update - Australia - Lloyds Shipping.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

AUSTRALIA, Nov 20 - Sydney - Industrial situation at 0900 hrs - At midnight on November 19 Maritime Union of Australia employees nationwide were directed by the union to withdraw their labour as a result of the passing of the industrial relations bill in the federal parliament. They returned to work at 0600 hrs today, November 20.
Brisbane - Members of the MUA employed on tugs went on strike from 2200, Nov 19, until 1000 hrs today, Nov 20.
Fremantle - Members of the MUA employed by Patricks will hold a stopwork meeting from 2130 hrs Nov 19 to 1430 hrs Nov 20.
